messages:
Carmen: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to attach a lightweight billing checkpoint at ingest vs continuing to rely on late enrichment. Link: https://rfd/repo/ingest-billing-checkpoint (draft). TL;DR: attach optional `billing_checkpoint` on ingest envelope so we can do early cost bucketing. Pros: lower cardinality during enrichment, easier SLO/Aggregation. Cons: router/SDK bump, more fields in hot path. Thoughts?

AJ: short +1 on lowering cardinality. question: what do we store in `billing_checkpoint`? full billing key or hashed id? storage delta matters.

Kai: leaning hashed id. If we store full org/service strings we explode index sizes over time. Hashing + metadata lookup at reporting time should be fine. Also need to consider retention: hot-tier cost increases if we add another high-card field.

Sam: example payload idea — keep it minimal: "billing_checkpoint": {"ver": 1, "hk": "sha256:abcd...", "meta": "team-x"}. hk = hashed key, meta optional short tag. That lets enrichment read hk and avoid re-resolving.

Carmen: exact — proposal is optional field, versioned. ingestion will set hk for routes that have customer mapping available (most server-side SDKs). Mobile SDKs may not. Behavior: enrichment should prefer `billing_checkpoint.hk` if present, fall back to late enrichment lookup. Backcompat maintained.

AJ: ping on metrics implications — dashboards currently roll up by `billing_key` string. With hashed hk we either need an offline mapping table (hk -> billing_key) for reports or change dashboards to accept hk. Mapping table adds join cost. Which is preferred?

Kai: prefer keeping hk as primary in hot storage and materialize periodic joins into metrics pipeline for human-friendly names. Avoid live joins in the trace path. We can run nightly job that writes hk->billing_key to the metrics store for the last 30d.

Sam: migration plan proposal: 1) ingest attach hk (no change to downstream) 2) enrichment read hk and emit `billing_id` field (unchanged schema) for analytics 3) after 60 days remove fallback lookup from enrichment and rely solely on hk->billing mapping for offline reports.

Carmen: risks: SDK bump cadence. If server SDKs are slow to ship hk, we'll have mixed coverage. Also sampled traces (1%) — sampled ones that go through enrichment may not have hk if ingestion sampling strips the envelope. We need to ensure sampled path preserves hk if present.

AJ: for sampled traces we should never drop hk. Add rule: sampling preserves envelope fields, including billing_checkpoint. If we already drop envelopes to reduce write QPS we might need to special-case billing.

Kai: another optimization — store `hk` as 8-byte prefix (first 64 bits) for hot index and full sha in cold storage. Good tradeoff between cardinality and collision risk; collisions acceptable for cost buckets if we detect anomalies.

Sam: regarding PII: since hk is a hash of billing id, we should salt it with a per-cluster secret and treat it as non-reversible. Add a note for audits and compliance.

Carmen: action items I propose: \n- implement ingest side: add optional `billing_checkpoint` v1 with `hk` + `meta` (Carmen will open PR)\n- enrichment change: prefer hk when present, emit `billing_id` for analytics if mapping found (Sam will prototype)\n- metrics pipeline: create nightly materialization job for hk->billing human name (Kai will draft)\n- gating: rollout canary 5% traffic eu-west for 48h and verify cardinality & cost delta (AJ to own canary)

AJ: +1. add dashboard cards to measure hot index size, ingest write bytes, and per-tenant metric cardinality so we can quantify impact before full rollout.

Kai: minor note — add feature flag behind `obs_ingest_billing_checkpoint_v1` to flip per-route until SDK coverage high.

obs-bot: Created tracking ticket OBS-1234: "ingest billing_checkpoint rollout + metrics materialization" and assigned to Carmen/AJ/Kai/Sam.

Carmen: OK I'll open the PR and include compatibility tests (SDK missing field, sampling preserved). Will post link once ready. :thumbsup:

Sam: small edgecase — when enrichment cannot resolve hk->billing (mapping lag) we should emit a `billing_unresolved:true` tag so we can filter those and not misattribute cost.

Carmen: good call. We'll add `billing_unresolved` boolean.

AJ: sounds solid. If we see any spikes in storage cost we can fallback by toggling the feature flag. :eyes:

Kai: thanks all. small doc task: I'll add a one-pager on collision model for 64-bit prefix.

Carmen: end of thread for now — will share RFC updates in the doc and the PR. Thanks everyone.
